description: This file defines a utility enum ToolResultTextFormatter with static methods for formatting and rendering JSON-based tool results into readable text. It handles different JSON structures, extracts relevant fields, sanitizes error messages, and provides summarized outputs such as node information or error statuses.

classes.name: ToolResultTextFormatter
classes.description: A utility enum providing static methods for formatting tool result texts, especially JSON responses, into readable strings.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Main entry point for formatting a text string based on whether it appears to be JSON, optionally considering the tool name.

methods.name: looksLikeJSON
methods.description: Checks whether the input string appears to be JSON, based on its first character.

methods.name: renderJSON
methods.description: Renders a JSON object into a human-readable string, handling dictionaries and arrays.

methods.name: renderDictionary
methods.description: renders a dictionary into a human-readable string, interpreting status, error, message, or special node summaries.

methods.name: renderNodesSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary string for a list of nodes, including details like connection status, platform, and version.

methods.name: pairingDetail
methods.description: Determines pairing status from node data, indicating if pairing is required.

methods.name: firstString
methods.description: Retrieves the first non-empty string value for a list of keys from a dictionary.

methods.name: sanitizeError
methods.description: Cleans up raw error messages by trimming, removing sensitive info, and truncating long messages.
